disclaimer: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Synthetic stewardship logic for a prototype; not clinical guidance.

pulmonary_source.description: The infection being treated is pneumonia / a lung source (daptomycin is inactivated by surfactant).

vre_isolated.description: VRE isolated from any specimen in the 14 days up to requested_at.

dapto_susceptible.description: The VRE isolate(s) in the window test daptomycin-susceptible (S). Null if no VRE or not tested.

mrsa_isolated.description: MRSA isolated from any specimen in the 14 days up to requested_at.

vanc_allergy_severity.description: Highest recorded severity of any vancomycin allergy/intolerance in the allergies table; 'none' if no row.

vanc_failure_or_intolerance.description: Clinical/microbiological failure on vancomycin (e.g. persistent bacteremia >= 72h on therapeutic levels, worsening) or documented vancomycin intolerance (vanc-attributed AKI, rash, infusion reaction NOT controllable by slowing the infusion).

egfr_latest.description: Most recent EGFR lab value (mL/min/1.73m2) collected at or before requested_at.

outcomes.APPROVE_ELIGIBLE: Criteria for restricted daptomycin met (dapto-susceptible VRE; MRSA with severe vancomycin allergy or vancomycin failure/intolerance).
outcomes.DENY_ELIGIBLE: Criteria not met: pulmonary source (daptomycin inactivated by surfactant), or vancomycin remains appropriate (incl. post-HD dosing). Routes to pharmacist, never auto-denied.
outcomes.PHARMACIST_REVIEW: Dapto-nonsusceptible VRE, vanc failure without MRSA/VRE isolate, or non-dialysis advanced CKD where avoiding vancomycin nephrotoxicity may matter.
outcomes.NEED_INFO: A variable needed on the decision path could not be determined from the record.
